metadata.summary: A comprehensive, multi-omics characterization of human cancers across 33 cancer types and more than 11,000 patients, combining genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic data with associated clinical and (for many cohorts) radiologic/pathology imaging via TCIA.
metadata.custodian: National Cancer Institute (NCI) and National Human Genome Research Institute
metadata.purpose: Molecular subtyping, biomarker discovery, and imaging-genomics research.

ethics.license: Open access with data use certification (GDC); dbGaP controlled access for some sensitive data.
ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification per HIPAA Safe Harbor; certificate of confidentiality; controlled access for germline/genomic data.
ethics.legal_compliance: Compliant with U.S. Common Rule, HIPAA, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。
pending_verification: geography.countries 由局限文本启发式推断，待人工核实
以下 LLM 字段因不符合 schema 约束已自动丢弃并回退基线值，待人工核实：medical_fields[list-items], modality/modalities[list-items]

bias_and_limitations.modifications: Data harmonized via GDC bioinformatics pipelines; some synthetic controls used in assay validation.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ US-based; underrepresentation of pediatric, global south, and certain racial/ethnic groups.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Rare cancer subtypes (e.g., adrenocortical carcinoma) have <100 cases.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Findings may not generalize to non-US populations or pediatric cancers due to demographic and technical biases.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Limited coverage of non-White racial groups; sparse longitudinal follow-up for some cohorts.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Variable completeness of clinical variables (e.g., treatment history, comorbidities) and imaging metadata.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support; direct diagnostic use without regulatory validation.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Retrospective collection across 33 cancer types to enable molecular subtyping and biomarker discovery.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Cohort-based recruitment across multiple institutions; cancer-type stratified sampling.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregated from >100 contributing institutions; harmonized via GDC pipelines with platform-specific normalization.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Cross-platform/batch heterogeneity; evolution of sequencing/imaging technologies over time (2006–2018).

population.target_population: Patients diagnosed with any of 33 cancer types.
population.inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of a TCGA-listed cancer type; availability of biospecimens and clinical data.
population.exclusion_criteria: Insufficient sample quality or missing core clinical annotations.
population.missing_groups: Pediatric cancers underrepresented; limited representation of non-US racial/ethnic minorities.

annotation.annotation_method: Pathology review by expert panels; molecular profiling via standardized assays; clinical annotation curation by site PIs.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Clinical and molecular labels derived from centralized biospecimen processing and expert pathology review.
annotation.label_noise_description: Inter-observer variability in histopathology grading; batch effects in molecular assays.
